item.title: Waterlogging in Khairatabad and Ameerpet after heavy rain; commuters stranded
item.description: Several low-lying areas of Hyderabad were inundated on Friday night as nalas overflowed. Residents said the storm-water drains had not been desilted before the monsoon, and traffic on the flyover was halted for hours while the GHMC deployed emergency teams.

item.title: Hyderabad Metro phase-II extension to the airport: work to begin next month
item.description: The project, estimated at ₹6,250 crore, will add 31 km to the network.
